summary.scope: Copied actual binary directory decode/upsert/sort/encode, fixed synthetic0/8/128-entry fixtures; before timing every output byte-equal. System allocator, no DB or source IO, no full malformed corpus, no macro admission.

differential_scope: For0/1/8/128-entry fixtures, every truncation length, every byte replaced by0/255, and trailing byte; complete encoded output or error kind/text matches. Not an exhaustive input-space proof.

source_findings.prepared_blob_publish: Sampled original frozen profiles show28-40us perturn.event.record for publication; authority commit explicitly excludes GC deletion after OCC validation through publication/commit. Moving it outside requires a new verified lease protocol.
source_findings.recency_bounds: Owner recency directory retains top128, not all1000 live conversations. Current binary decoder allocates one Vec perID; borrowed slices remove those ID allocations in a standalone decode/update/sort/encode control.
source_findings.second_validation: After business rebase to current head, prepare_commit validation returns immediately when snapshot==head; do not claim duplicated full OCC validation here.

limitations: No native runtime/source change admitted; no actual database latency gain.
System allocator, fixed synthetic fixtures; native mimalloc and authority index path not measured.
Standalone timings are not subtractable from sampled commit or productive FIFO delay.
Borrowed control keeps existing binary checks and sorts before encoding; native read/backfill lifetimes not yet implemented or verified.
Serialized commit prefix/index cost has not been independently attributed; small micro saving cannot explain entire1s miss.
next_action: Evaluate shared borrowed binary decoder with owner/deadline/backfill/read-your-writes and publication fault contracts, then measure real native counterpart before admission.
